content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects us to request IR spectrum to see carbonyl stretch. However we need the compound structure. Maybe the environment has a default sample? The tool ir_spectra expects no arguments, but we passed empty dict incorrectly. The signature: ir_spectra = (_: {}) => any; So we should call with empty object {}. The earlier call gave error because we passed {"": {}}. Let's call correctly.
